name: Little Pamela
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
So many of us died at the battle of Darrowshire.  So many died... and worse.

When the battle began I hid my niece Pamela, and I do not know what happened to her.  I am but a wandering spirit, but my heart still longs to know Pamela's fate.

Please, good champion.  Will you go to Darrowshire and search for her?  It is to the east, beyond Gahrron's Withering.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hello.  I'm Pamela, what's your name?
